items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: Bunny Robine was mastering as he did the transfers... he probably, you know, saved my chestnuts a few times with stuff that I did

ctx.x: You either did it then or you didn't do it.

You didn't do it. I couldn't... You couldn't do it. Now, I'll say this. There was a guy, Bunny Robine, who was the mastering engineer for Imperial and all of the independents just about on the West Coast at master recorders. Bunny Robine... And that's spelled O-R-O-P-Y-N incidentally. Uh, uh, uh, uh, Bunny Robine was mastering as he did the transfers from, from tape to disc and disc to disc and things like that. Mm-hmm. And he was excellent. Very, very good. And, uh, he probably, you know, saved my chestnuts a…
In other words, made not mistakes, but just because of the... You, you, you just didn't have the...
